create_sequence_penalty_criterion: create a fairseq criterion that penalizes n-gram repetitions in generated sequences during training
run_sequence_penalty_forward: run the sequence penalty loss forward pass to compute unlikelihood-based penalty on token completions
build_ngram_repeat_mask: build a binary mask identifying repeated n-gram subsequences in generated token sequences
aggregate_sequence_penalty_logs: aggregate per-batch logging outputs from data parallel training into normalized metrics
test_sequence_penalty_criterion: test the sequence penalty criterion with repeat and random candidate types for n-gram penalty
